title: DEVIL CHAT
features:
😈 DEVIL CHAT V3.1 🔥
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
POWERED BY RX ENGINE ⚡

An advanced, standalone chat system that connects players through an external Server. Say goodbye to Roblox's default chat restrictions and enjoy a fully customized, feature-rich communication hub right inside your game.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

✦ FEATURES
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
✅ External Server Backend — Real-time, independent messaging across servers.
✅ Custom Memes & Stickers — Send images to the chat.
✅ Synced Music Player — Play custom MP3s from your executor workspace and sync them globally for everyone.
✅ Private Messaging — Send messages only to specific users.
✅ Advanced Roles — Custom tags and colors for Owner, Authors, Admins, and Knights.
✅ Custom UI — Draggable, animated, and styled beautifully in Devil Red.
✅ Reply System — Swipe to reply directly to messages.
✅ Chat Commands — Use /syncmemes, /clearmemes, /dedupemusic, etc.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

✦ HOW TO USE
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
1. Execute the script in your executor.
2. Wait for the custom loading screen to finish.
3. Click the floating 😈 button to open the chat.
4. To use custom memes, place .png files in your executor's `workspace/rx_memes` folder.
5. To use custom music, place .mp3 files in your executor's `workspace/rx_music` folder.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

✦ NOTE FOR MODERATORS (Please Read)
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
Because this is an external chat client, it uses specific functions that may look suspicious to automated scanners but are completely safe:
• `HttpService` / `syn.request`: Used exclusively for reading and writing messages to our secure Server database.
• `writefile` / `readfile` / `listfiles`: Used ONLY to save and load custom `.png` memes and `.mp3` music into the executor's workspace folder. It does not read or exfiltrate personal files.
• No hidden payloads: There are no token loggers, cookie stealers, or unauthorized remote executions in this client.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
